name: RoomOutOfOrderManager
tagline: Get every out-of-order room approved, repaired, inspected and back on sale – on time.
description: Complete hotel out-of-order / out-of-service app for Power Apps and Power Pages: request, approve by room-night limits, hand off to engineering, inspect and return rooms; rooms out per room type and night against your limit, revenue displacement, overlap and guest-conflict checks, overdue returns and extensions.
features: Inventory heat map per room type and night with max-OOO limit
Engineering hand-off with work order and engineer
OOO / OOS conversion and OOS-too-long warning
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (2 controls: RoomOutOfOrderManager data set + RoomOutOfOrderManagerPortal field control)
